body.purpose: Compare two to four vendors' supply volume for the SAME date window.
when_to_use: Compare two to four vendors' supply volume for the SAME date window.
when_not_to_use: For one vendor use get_vendor_summary. Do not claim volume proves best quality or reliability.

rules: 2–4 distinct canonical IDs, including zero-supply vendors.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
